$comment: How big the figure is, in metres. The model build scales the assembled body and head so the top of the skull is at `height`, barefoot, and stands the figure `bootHeelHeight` above the ground, which is the thickness of the boots' soles. Limb lengths and every other proportion are the body base's own; the head is the face's own size times HEAD_SCALE in blender/scripts/build_cass.py.
